item.title: Solar eclipse
item.description: Solar eclipse A total solar eclipse occurs when the Moon completely covers the Sun's disk. Solar prominences can be seen along the limb (in red) as well as extensively the coronal and partly the radiating coronal streamers. (August 11, 1999) An annular solar eclipse occurs when the Moon is too far away to completely cover the Sun's disk (October 14, 2023).
